body.zh-Hant: 東郷平八郎生於弘化4年12月22日（西曆1848年1月27日），父親是鹿兒島藩士。他曾隨軍參加戊辰戰爭，明治維新後於明治4年（1871年）赴英國海軍留學，歸國後出任海軍中尉。
body.en: Tōgō Heihachirō was born on 22 December of Kōka 4 (27 January 1848 in the Western calendar), the son of a Kagoshima domain samurai. He served in the Boshin War, went to study with the British navy in Meiji 4 (1871), and on returning home became a navy lieutenant.

body.en: In July 1894 Captain Tōgō of the cruiser Naniwa sank the British ship Kowshing, which was carrying Qing troops, causing an international dispute. His handling accorded with the law of war and instead raised his reputation.

heading.zh-Hant: 聯合艦隊司令長官與日本海海戰
heading.en: Combined Fleet command and the Battle of Tsushima

body.zh-Hant: 日俄戰爭前的明治36年（1903年），他就任聯合艦隊司令長官，並親自指揮主要作戰。聯合艦隊曾三次實施旅順港封鎖作戰。明治38年（1905年）5月27日，聯合艦隊在對馬東方近海迎擊波羅的海艦隊，該艦隊的戰艦6艘、裝甲巡洋艦3艘、驅逐艦4艘等沉沒，聯合艦隊則僅損失水雷艇3艘等。這場海戰即日本海海戰。
body.en: In Meiji 36 (1903), before the Russo-Japanese War, he became commander-in-chief of the Combined Fleet and personally directed its main operations. The fleet carried out three Port Arthur blockade operations. On 27 May 1905 it met the Russian Baltic Fleet in the waters east of Tsushima; six battleships, three armoured cruisers and four destroyers of that fleet were sunk, while the Combined Fleet lost only torpedo boats and the like. This was the Battle of the Sea of Japan (Tsushima).

heading.en: Waiting at Chinhae Bay after the fall of Port Arthur

body.zh-Hant: 明治38年（1905年）1月1日旅順陷落後，東郷仍持續停留在鎮海灣。該論文記載，東郷長官於1月2日將艦隊全力配置於鎮海灣，視機應變。同年4月10日，東郷長官就敵情判斷向伊東祐亨海軍軍令部長答電。
body.en: After Port Arthur fell on 1 January 1905, Tōgō kept staying at Chinhae Bay. The paper records that on 2 January the commander placed the whole fleet at Chinhae Bay to act as occasion required, and on 10 April he sent a reply on his assessment of the enemy to Naval General Staff chief Itō Sukeyuki.

heading.en: Chief of Naval General Staff, marshal and later years

body.zh-Hant: 明治40年（1907年）6月，身為海軍軍令部長的東郷致函元帥大山巖，表示要寄上今後可供參考的資料，包括日俄戰爭時取得的俄軍秘密文書。大正2年（1913年）他晉升元帥，自大正3年起連續7年擔任東宮御學問所總裁。進入昭和時期後，他作為海軍長老仍有很大影響力，於昭和9年5月30日去世。
body.en: In June 1907 Tōgō, then Chief of the Naval General Staff, wrote to Marshal Ōyama Iwao offering materials for future reference, including secret Russian documents obtained during the war. He became a marshal in Taishō 2 (1913) and from Taishō 3 served for seven years as head of the Crown Prince's Academy. He remained an influential navy elder into the Shōwa era and died on 30 May 1934.

body.zh-Hant: 乃木希典生於嘉永2年11月11日（西曆1849年12月25日），父親是長府藩士，他曾參加第二次長州征討。明治4年（1871年）任陸軍少佐，其後從軍參加萩之亂與西南戰爭；明治20年為研究戰術，與川上操六同赴德國留學。
body.en: Nogi Maresuke was born on 11 November of Kaei 2 (25 December 1849), the son of a Chōfu domain samurai, and took part in the Second Chōshū Expedition. He was commissioned an army major in Meiji 4 (1871), served in the Hagi Rebellion and the Satsuma Rebellion, and in Meiji 20 went to Germany with Kawakami Sōroku to study tactics.

heading.en: Siege of Port Arthur and Battle of Mukden

body.zh-Hant: 日俄戰爭中，乃木希典以第3軍司令官身分指揮旅順攻略，對旅順要塞的總攻擊共實施3次，過程極為艱難。明治37年（1904年）12月6日，第3軍攻佔203高地；翌年1月再攻下望台，使旅順的俄軍投降。明治38年（1905年）3月的奉天會戰中，第3軍繞到俄軍北方，企圖截斷其退路。
body.en: In the Russo-Japanese War Nogi commanded the Third Army in the attack on Port Arthur, which proved extremely difficult; the fortress was assaulted in three general attacks. On 6 December 1904 the Third Army took 203 Metre Hill, and in January 1905 it also took Wangtai, after which the Russian forces at Port Arthur surrendered. In the Battle of Mukden in March 1905 the Third Army moved round the Russian north to cut off its retreat.

heading.en: After the war, the Peers' School and death

body.zh-Hant: 明治38年（1905年）11月21日，他在法庫門等待復員時寫信給石黑忠悳，回答對方關於西南戰爭、甲午與日俄各戰爭所用軍銃的詢問。戰後他任軍事參議官；明治40年（1907年）起奉明治天皇之意兼任學習院院長。明治天皇大喪之日，他與妻子靜子一同殉死，卒於大正元年9月13日（西曆1912年9月13日）。
body.en: On 21 November 1905, while waiting at Fakumen to be demobilised, he answered an inquiry from Ishiguro Tadanori about the rifles used in the Satsuma Rebellion and the Sino- and Russo-Japanese wars. After the war he became a Supreme War Councillor and, from Meiji 40 (1907), concurrently headed the Peers' School at the Emperor Meiji's wish. On the day of Emperor Meiji's state funeral he died by junshi together with his wife Shizuko, on 13 September 1912 (Taishō 1).

body.en: Tōjō Hideki was born on 30 December Meiji 17 (1884), the son of the army officer Tōjō Hidenori. He graduated from the Army Academy (17th class) in March 1905 and from the Army War College (27th class) in December 1915. He became a major general in March 1933 and a lieutenant general in December 1936; chief of staff of the Kwantung Army in March 1937, Vice-Minister of the Army in May 1938, and that December Inspector General of Aviation and head of the Army Air Headquarters.

body.zh-Hant: 首相任內，日軍於12月8日展開馬來進攻作戰與珍珠港攻擊，太平洋戰爭爆發。昭和17年8月起的瓜達爾卡納爾島戰役使陸海軍作戰開始崩潰，日軍於18年2月自該島撤退，5月阿圖島守軍玉碎，9月22日美澳聯軍確保丹皮爾海峽。昭和18年9月30日，在東條主持下舉行御前會議，決定「絕對國防圈」構想。
body.en: During his premiership the Japanese forces launched the Malayan offensive and the Pearl Harbor attack on 8 December, opening the Pacific War. The Guadalcanal campaign, begun in August 1942, started to unravel the army and navy operations; Japan withdrew from the island in February 1943, Attu fell in May, and on 22 September US-Australian forces secured the Dampier Strait. On 30 September 1943 an Imperial Conference held under Tōjō's direction adopted the "absolute national defence sphere" concept.

heading.en: Chief of General Staff, resignation and trial

body.zh-Hant: 昭和19年2月他兼任參謀總長；隨戰局惡化，重臣內部的批評升高，7月內閣總辭並轉入預備役。戰敗後他試圖自殺未遂，在遠東國際軍事審判中以甲級戰犯被判絞刑，於昭和23年12月23日去世。
body.en: In February 1944 he also took the post of Chief of the Army General Staff; as the war situation worsened, criticism among the elder statesmen grew, and in July the cabinet resigned and he was placed on the reserve list. After the surrender he attempted suicide without success, was sentenced to hang as a Class-A war criminal by the International Military Tribunal for the Far East, and died on 23 December 1948.

heading.zh-Hant: 海軍軍令部改編為軍令部
heading.en: Reorganisation of the Naval General Staff

body.zh-Hant: 1933年（昭和8年）10月1日，海軍軍令部在伏見宮博恭王擔任部長時改編為軍令部，實現了大正末期以來海軍軍令部內部希望提升對海軍省地位的願望。這次改編使軍令部的權限增強，歷史影響很大。
body.en: On 1 October 1933 (Shōwa 8) the Naval General Staff Office was reorganised as the Naval General Staff while Prince Fushimi Hiroyasu was its head, realising a wish held inside the staff since the late Taishō period to raise its standing against the Navy Ministry. The reorganisation strengthened its powers, with a large historical impact.

body.zh-Hant: 古賀峯一於1885年9月25日生於佐賀縣有田。他進入海軍兵學校第34期，1906年畢業，在176名同期生中名列第14。少尉候補生時隨松島艦服役。1917年升少佐並被派往海外的法國，直到1922年；1926年12月1日晉升大佐，其後擔任駐巴黎海軍武官，至1928年11月1日。
body.en: Mineichi Koga was born on 25 September 1885 in Arita, Saga Prefecture. He entered the 34th class of the Imperial Japanese Navy Academy and graduated 14th of 176 in 1906. He served as a midshipman aboard Matsushima. Promoted lieutenant commander in 1917, he was sent overseas to France until 1922; promoted captain on 1 December 1926, he served as naval attaché in Paris until 1 November 1928.

heading.zh-Hant: 將官時期、艦隊指揮與香港作戰
heading.en: Flag rank, fleet commands and the Hong Kong operation

body.zh-Hant: 1932年12月31日古賀晉升少將，1933年轉任海軍軍令部第三部情報部門長。1936年12月31日升任軍令部次長，其後在1937年中日戰爭爆發前就任。1939年，他出任第二艦隊司令長官；1941年9月1日起任支那方面艦隊司令長官。1941年12月，他指揮香港戰役中對香港的海軍作戰，直到該月底。
body.en: Koga was promoted rear admiral on 31 December 1932 and in 1933 became chief of the Naval General Staff Intelligence Division. On 31 December 1936 he was promoted Vice Chief of the Navy General Staff. In 1939 he became commander of the 2nd Fleet, and on 1 September 1941 commander of the China Area Fleet. In December 1941 he commanded the naval operations against Hong Kong (the Hong Kong campaign) until the end of the month.

body.zh-Hant: 1943年4月21日，古賀被任命為連合艦隊司令長官，接替4月18日搭機身亡的山本五十六；任命遲至1943年5月才公開。1944年3月下旬，他正監督連合艦隊司令部自帛琉撤離。3月30日他搭乘H8K2飛艇飛往民答那峨島的納卯，遇颱風，於3月31日凌晨2時墜海，古賀殉職，死訊遲至1944年5月才在日本公布。山本、古賀兩任連合艦隊司令長官相繼陣亡，海軍敗勢難以挽回。
body.en: On 21 April 1943 Koga was appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Combined Fleet, replacing Admiral Isoroku Yamamoto, who had died on 18 April; the appointment was not made public until May 1943. In late March 1944 overseeing the withdrawal of the Combined Fleet headquarters from Palau. On 30 March he took off on an H8K2 flying boat bound for Davao on Mindanao, flew into a typhoon and crashed into the sea at 2:00 am on 31 March, and Koga was killed; his death was announced in Japan only in May 1944. Two successive Combined Fleet commanders, Yamamoto and Koga, were killed.
